name: Alphabet

eyebrow.en: Alphabet Inc. · Class A · Mountain View, California
eyebrow.zh: Alphabet · A类股 · 加州山景城

title.en: Search still pays, Cloud is the rocket.
title.zh: 搜索仍在赚钱，云业务一飞冲天。

lede.en: Alphabet grew revenue 25% to $127.6B in Q3, its thirteenth straight double-digit quarter, as Google Cloud more than doubled, up 103%. The cost is capex: $51.4B in the quarter, with $195–205B planned this year and significantly more in 2027, which pushed free cash flow to −$9.1B, its second negative quarter in a row.
lede.zh: Alphabet 第三季营收增 25% 至 1276 亿美元，连续第13个季度双位数增长，Google Cloud 增长 103%，规模翻倍有余。代价是资本开支：单季 514 亿美元，今年计划 1950–2050 亿美元，2027 年还将显著增加，令自由现金流降至 −91 亿美元，连续第二个季度为负。

s.en: FY2027 consensus EPS $15.35 · trailing GAAP ~17× incl. investment gains
s.zh: 2027 财年一致预期每股 $15.35 · 含投资收益的 GAAP 历史约 17 倍
一致预期 · 区间 $350–485 · Q4 营收预期约 1421 亿

sub_price.en: Daily closes with the 50-day average. The stock traded between about $274 and $403 over the past year.
sub_price.zh: 每日收盘价与50日均线。过去一年股价在约 $274 至 $403 间。

sub_rev.en: Revenue in US$ millions, with gross margin on the right axis. Q3 2026 GAAP EPS of $2.12 includes an $8.7B loss on equity stakes (−$0.55 a share), after about $99B of gains lifted Q2 to $9.11. Alphabet gives no revenue guidance, so the last bar is analyst consensus for Q4 2026, implied from the full-year estimate.
sub_rev.zh: 营收单位为百万美元，右轴为毛利率。2026 第三季 GAAP 每股 $2.12 含 87 亿美元股权投资亏损（每股 −$0.55），而第二季因约 990 亿美元收益被推高至 $9.11。Alphabet 不提供营收指引，最后一根柱为由全年预期推算的 2026 第四季分析师一致预期。

s.zh: 同比 +25% · 连续13季双位数
一致预期约 $3.02 · 持股亏损 87 亿
维持 · Q3 为 514 亿 · 2027 年"显著"更高

p.en: Cloud growth sped up from 48% at the end of 2025 to 63% in Q1, 82% in Q2 and 103% in Q3, and operating income tripled to $11.1B at a 36.2% margin. Sales of TPU systems were a meaningful contributor.
p.zh: 云业务增速由 2025 年底的 48% 提升至 Q1 的 63%、Q2 的 82% 和 Q3 的 103%，营业利润增至三倍达 111 亿美元，利润率 36.2%。TPU 系统销售贡献显著。

p.en: Search revenue growth slowed to 12% from 17% as it lapped a strong quarter, and YouTube ads to 9% from 13%. Query growth was the fastest in five years and the Gemini app reached 1B users.
p.zh: 搜索收入增速因基数较高由 17% 放缓至 12%，YouTube 广告由 13% 放缓至 9%。查询量增速为五年来最快，Gemini 应用用户达 10 亿。

p.en: The 2026 capex guide stayed at $195–205B; with $132B spent in nine months, Q4 implies $63–73B. 2027 will be "significantly" higher, with details on the Q4 call. Buybacks remain paused; Q3 added $28.7B of notes and $12.4B of stock sold at the market.
p.zh: 2026 年资本开支指引维持 1950–2050 亿美元；前九个月已花 1320 亿，意味着第四季需 630–730 亿。2027 年将"显著"更高，详情将在第四季电话会公布。回购仍暂停；第三季新增 287 亿美元票据及 124 亿美元按市价发行股票。

h.zh: 账面收益扰动每股收益

p.en: Q2 net income included about $99B of unrealized gains, mostly on the SpaceX stake; in Q3 an $8.7B loss on equity securities cut EPS by $0.55 and drove the miss. GAAP earnings will move with those holdings.
p.zh: 第二季净利润含约 990 亿美元未实现收益，主要来自 SpaceX 持股；第三季股权证券亏损 87 亿美元，使每股收益减少 $0.55，导致不及预期。GAAP 盈利会随这些持股波动。

p.en: Free cash flow was −$9.1B against near-breakeven expectations. Management says demand still exceeds capacity; cloud growth depends on getting chips, power and data centers online, partly through third-party capacity.
p.zh: 自由现金流为 −91 亿美元，而市场预期接近收支平衡。管理层表示需求仍超过产能；云业务增长取决于芯片、电力和数据中心能否到位，部分依赖第三方算力。

p.en: US antitrust cases over search and ad tech remain an overhang on how Google distributes search and sells ads.
p.zh: 美国针对搜索与广告技术的反垄断案仍对 Google 的搜索分发与广告销售构成压力。

h.zh: 第四季及 2026 全年业绩

p.en: Expected to include the 2027 capex outlook. Consensus Q4 revenue ~$142B.
p.zh: 预计将给出 2027 年资本开支展望。第四季营收一致预期约 1421 亿美元。

foot.en: Fundamentals as of Oct 28, 2026 (Q3 2026 results). For information only, not investment advice. Not affiliated with Alphabet Inc..
foot.zh: 基本面数据截至 2026年10月28日（2026 第三季业绩）。仅供参考，不构成投资建议。与 Alphabet Inc. 无关联。

sub.en: Free cash flow is operating cash flow minus capital spending, in US$ millions, for the 20 quarters from Q4 2021 to Q3 2026. Shaded bars and italic rows are estimates.
sub.zh: 自由现金流 = 经营现金流 − 资本开支，单位百万美元，涵盖 2021 年第四季至 2026 年第三季共 20 个季度。浅色柱与斜体行为估算。

read.en: Alphabet has been one of the most reliable cash machines in the market: free cash flow of $13–25B in most quarters and about $289B over these five years, which paid for $13–16B of buybacks a quarter. That changed in 2026. Capex more than doubled from a year earlier to $51.4B in Q3, operating cash flow slipped to $42.3B and free cash flow was −$9.1B, the second negative quarter in a row.
read.zh: Alphabet 一直是市场上最稳定的现金机器之一：多数季度自由现金流 130–250 亿美元，五年合计约 2890 亿，足以支撑每季 130–160 亿美元的回购。2026 年情况改变：第三季资本开支同比翻倍有余至 514 亿美元，经营现金流降至 423 亿，自由现金流 −91 亿，连续第二个季度为负。

read.en: With 2026 capex guided at $195–205B and $132.0B spent in the first nine months, Q4 needs $63–73B against roughly $50B of operating cash flow. I expect about −$18B in Q4 and a similar or bigger gap each quarter of 2027 as capex rises again, roughly −$84B over four quarters. Funding keeps coming: Q3 added $28.7B of notes and $12.4B of stock sold at the market, with $27.6B of that program left, and cash and securities rose to $265.1B.
read.zh: 2026 年资本开支指引 1950–2050 亿美元，前九个月已花 1320 亿，第四季需 630–730 亿，而经营现金流约 500 亿。我预计第四季约 −180 亿美元，2027 年随资本开支再升，每季缺口相当或更大，四季合计约 −840 亿。融资持续：第三季新增 287 亿美元票据及 124 亿美元按市价发行股票，该计划尚余 276 亿额度，现金及有价证券升至 2651 亿美元。

p.en: Q3 capex was $51.4B, up from $24.0B a year earlier; the full-year guide implies $63–73B in Q4.
p.zh: 第三季资本开支 514 亿美元，一年前为 240 亿；全年指引意味着第四季 630–730 亿。

p.en: About $2.9B a quarter including the preferred. No buybacks in 2026 so far, after $28B in the first half of 2025.
p.zh: 含优先股每季约 29 亿美元。2025 年上半年回购 280 亿后，2026 年至今未回购。

p.en: Q3 interest expense was $967M, still below $1.8B of interest income, after $56B of net debt in the first half and $28.7B of notes in Q3.
p.zh: 第三季利息支出 9.67 亿美元，仍低于 18 亿利息收入；上半年净举债 560 亿，第三季再发 287 亿票据。

p.en: Google Services earned $96.3B of revenue in Q3, up 11%, with $39.2B of operating income, and still funds most of the build-out.
p.zh: 第三季 Google 服务营收 963 亿美元，增长 11%，营业利润 392 亿，仍是扩建的主要资金来源。

p.en: $514B of contracted cloud work yet to be booked as revenue at the end of June; the Q3 release gives no update.
p.zh: 截至6月底已签约但尚未确认的云业务收入达 5140 亿美元；第三季财报未更新该数字。

p.en: Q3 2026: $28.7B of senior notes and $12.4B of Class A and C stock sold at the market. First half: $56.2B net debt, $30.5B of common stock and $19.1B of mandatory convertible preferred.
p.zh: 2026 年第三季：287 亿美元优先无担保票据及 124 亿美元按市价发行 A 类和 C 类股。上半年：净债务 562 亿美元、普通股 305 亿、强制可转换优先股 191 亿。

bridgeNote.en: Excludes further at-the-market stock sales ($27.6B left at Sep 30), new bond issues and any restart of buybacks.
bridgeNote.zh: 未计入进一步按市价发行股票（9月30日尚余 276 亿）、新发债券或恢复回购。

extraNote.en: Gains and losses on equity stakes such as SpaceX and Anthropic do not affect cash flow. The cash figure is from the Q3 release balance sheet.
extraNote.zh: SpaceX、Anthropic 等持股的收益与亏损不影响现金流。现金数字取自第三季财报资产负债表。
